instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width. Lower the bar to mid-chest with control, then press up until your arms are fully extended.
name: Barbell Bench Press

instructions: Set the bench to about 30 degrees. Press the dumbbells from chest level to full extension, keeping your back flat against the bench.
name: Incline Dumbbell Press

instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms straight. Lower your body by bending the elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows, then press back up.
name: Dip

instructions: Stand with the bar at shoulder height. Brace your core and press the bar overhead until your arms lock out, keeping your ribs down.
name: Overhead Press

instructions: With a slight bend in the elbows, raise the dumbbells out to your sides until they reach shoulder height, then lower slowly.
name: Lateral Raise

instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip. Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down, then lower under control.
name: Pull-Up

instructions: Hinge forward about 45 degrees with a flat back. Row the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top.
name: Barbell Row

instructions: Sit tall and pull the bar down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your ribs. Control the weight back up.
name: Lat Pulldown

instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the bar over mid-foot. Hinge at the hips, grip the bar, and stand up by driving your hips forward while keeping your back flat.
name: Conventional Deadlift

instructions: Rest the bar across your upper back. Sit down between your heels until your hips are below your knees, keeping your chest up, then drive back up.
name: Barbell Back Squat

instructions: With a slight knee bend, push your hips back and lower the weight along your thighs until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward.
name: Romanian Deadlift

instructions: Step forward into a lunge, lowering until both knees are near 90 degrees. Push through your front heel to step into the next lunge.
name: Walking Lunge

instructions: Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform. Lower the weight until your knees reach about 90 degrees, then press without locking your knees.
name: Leg Press

instructions: Stand tall with the bar at thigh level. Curl the bar toward your shoulders without swinging, squeezing at the top, then lower slowly.
name: Barbell Curl

instructions: Pin your elbows at your sides and push the bar down until your arms are straight. Let it rise slowly back to the starting position.
name: Triceps Pushdown

instructions: Hold your body in a straight line from head to heels, supported on your forearms and toes. Brace your abs and breathe steadily.
name: Plank
